units.source_text: 我想听父亲说下去，可父亲似乎不想再往下说了，但最终还是对我说出了一番话：

en.t: I wanted to hear Father go on, but he seemed not to want to say any more; in the end, however, he said this to me:

units.source_text: “要说我为什么这么说嘛，你也知道，我得了这么个病。

en.t: If you want to know why I say that, well, as you know, I have this illness.

units.source_text: 去年冬天见到你的时候，我以为弄不好顶多还能活三四个月，

en.t: When I saw you last winter, I thought that at worst I might have only three or four months left,

units.source_text: 可不知哪辈子修来的福，一直到现在还好好的，也不用旁人伺候。

en.t: but by some blessing I have stayed well until now and have not needed anyone to look after me.

units.source_text: 就在这个当儿，你大学毕了业，我哪能不高兴呢。

en.t: At just such a time, you graduated from university; how could I not be happy?

units.source_text: 我们做父母的，能够活着看到这么有出息的儿子走出校门，不是比我死了以后你才毕业，更叫人欢喜吗？

en.t: For us as parents, isn't it far happier to live to see such a promising son leave school than for you to graduate only after I am dead?

units.source_text: 在心气儿高的你看来，一个大学毕业生也没什么了不起，我却没完没了地说太好了，让你觉得难为情吧。

en.t: To someone ambitious like you, graduating from university may not seem like much, and my going on and on about how wonderful it is probably made you feel embarrassed.

units.source_text: 可站在你爸的角度，就不一样啦。

en.t: But from your father's point of view, it is different.

units.source_text: 总之，你小子毕业这事儿，我这当老子的肯定要比你高兴了。

en.t: In short, as your father, I am certainly happier about your graduation than you are.

units.source_text: 我一句话也说不出来，羞愧难当地低下了头。

en.t: I could not say a word and lowered my head in unbearable shame.

units.source_text: 虽然父亲表面上很平静，但他似乎已经预感到了自己的死，而且认定可能会死在我毕业之前。

en.t: Although Father appeared calm on the surface, he seemed already to have foreseen his own death and to have convinced himself that he might die before I graduated.

units.source_text: 而我却没有去想，自己的毕业会在父亲心中产生多么大的影响，真是太糊涂了。

en.t: Yet I had never thought about what a great effect my graduation would have on Father's heart; I had been terribly foolish.

units.source_text: 我从皮箱里拿出毕业证书，恭恭敬敬地递给父母。

en.t: I took my diploma out of my suitcase and respectfully handed it to my parents.

units.source_text: 毕业证书被压出了褶皱，没有原来那么平整了，父亲小心翼翼地把它展开。

en.t: The diploma had been pressed into creases and was no longer as smooth as it had been; Father carefully spread it open.

units.source_text: “这么要紧的东西应该卷好，拿在手里的。”

en.t: "Something this important should be rolled up properly and carried in your hand."
